mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.deleted, CASE WHEN c.deleted = 1 THEN NULL ELSE c.content END AS content, c.user_id, c.reply_to_id, c.created_at, u.username AS user_name, ru.username AS reply_to_user_name FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comment rc ON c.reply_to_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON rc.user_id = ru.id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC,c.id ASC
